original_annotation.notes: A circle of 8 spikes/pillars/ripples of energy emerges with an upward pulsing movement around the entity in three phases, each with the circle expanding in radius. layered_studies.purpose: Compact hand accent; leaves the projectile silhouette clear.

layered_studies.purpose: A fuller hand trail plus body accent; no decorative floor ring.

layered_studies.purpose: Short hand release plus tight body contour.

layered_studies.label: Broad invocation
layered_studies.purpose: Body opening and rising energy; inspect the early orbit for competing geometry.

layered_studies.label: Ground invocation
layered_studies.purpose: Intentional large ground signature; not a default addition to all casts.

layered_studies.label: Necrotic signature
layered_studies.purpose: Skull is the chosen signature; its size must be judged beside the Godot effect.

layered_studies.label: Magical arrow gesture
layered_studies.purpose: Pose study only: does not supply artwork for a spectral bow.

layered_studies.label: Intentional congestion comparison
layered_studies.purpose: Not recommended: shows why simply stacking effects is not spell progression.

progression_guidance: Select pose by delivery direction and gesture, not level alone.
Use Magic1–3 for the hand style; Effect5 is a tighter accent and Effect4 a broader/brighter one.
For stronger presentation, use one intentional signature or a fuller body accent, not every available layer.
Keep Effect1–3 wide floor/orbit/skull shapes deliberate; a shared palette cannot remove their geometry.
Repeated, multi-target and rapid casts need restraint even at high levels.
A larger casting flourish must not communicate a false mechanical area or extra impact.

material_study.method: Exact palette replacement versus an existing authored hand-noise treatment under the same alpha mask. Full Godot material transfer is not claimed.

source_receipt.provenance: Existing delivered hand-noise resource; copied by devtools/import_ice_spells.py, currently selected by the Chill Touch treatment.
source_receipt.not_a_material_transfer: No Godot lighting, simulation, distortion, bloom, normals or XYZ has been transferred. Third variant reuses the existing accepted necrotic ramp; it is an explicit material comparison, not automatic three-color inheritance.

material_study.visual_observation: Noise makes the same skull more mottled; the accepted necrotic ramp makes it markedly darker. Neither changes its large silhouette. These are alternatives to compare, not an automatic improvement.
limits: Silhouette, ground footprint and timing remain from the modular sheet.
A flat mask has no surface normals/XYZ or volumetric lighting.
No new runtime shader or production binding is introduced.
